Sample Person Seven
Operations Manager | Process Improvement, Supply Chain and Inventory | Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
San Diego, California

About
Operations manager with six years in distribution and supply chain. My work is process improvement: I find the step that slows everyone down and I remove it.

At Example Distribution I run a 45-person operation shipping 9,000 orders a week. Over the last two years my team cut mis-picks by 40%, raised on-time shipping from 91% to 98%, and absorbed a 25% volume increase without adding headcount. I led the rollout of a new warehouse management system across two sites and trained every shift on it.

I am a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt and I use those tools every week, not just on the certificate.

If you are working on a similar problem, connect with me. I am always happy to trade notes.
